name: Kratika Yoga Platform Design Language
description: Reusable visual direction and design tokens for customer-facing yoga platform screens and image-generation prompts.

forest.usage: Primary buttons, headings, logo, active navigation and high-emphasis text

sage.usage: Secondary accents, inactive states, subtle icons and supporting elements

terracotta.usage: Links, small highlights, quotation marks and warm accent details

slate.usage: Secondary text, placeholders and helper copy

border.usage: Input borders, card dividers and subtle outlines

softSurface.usage: Secondary backgrounds, selected panels and subtle information areas

success.usage: Completed lessons, successful payments and confirmations

focus.usage: Keyboard focus rings and active form borders

overlay.usage: Text panels over photography and modal overlays

heading.style: Elegant editorial serif with restrained line height

body.style: Clean modern sans-serif optimized for readability

principles: Use generous whitespace around headings and forms
Keep primary tasks within a focused content column
Use asymmetric editorial layouts for marketing and authentication pages
Stack split layouts vertically on mobile
Keep touch targets at least 44px high

shadow.rule: Use shadows sparingly; prefer borders and whitespace

imagery.direction: Editorial wellness photography with real people practicing yoga naturally in warm, uncluttered spaces.
imagery.lighting: Soft natural morning or golden-hour window light
environment: wood, stone, cotton and woven natural materials
composition: Leave negative space for interface content when needed
Use calm seated or foundational poses
Prefer candid expressions and believable posture
Keep backgrounds clean and softly detailed

authenticationScreen.desktopLayout: Approximately 52% form area and 48% editorial image area
authenticationScreen.mobileLayout: Single-column form; image becomes a compact header image or is hidden

requirements: Never rely on color alone for status
Associate every input with a visible label
Keep body text at least 16px where practical
Provide descriptive alternative text for meaningful images

imageGenerationPromptTemplate.style: Premium modern wellness UI, editorial, calm and production-ready
imageGenerationPromptTemplate.paletteInstruction: Use warm ivory #F7F3EC, deep forest green #213D34, muted sage #879C86, terracotta #C98768, white #FFFFFF, charcoal #24302C, slate #66716D and border gray #D8DDD8.
imageGenerationPromptTemplate.typographyInstruction: Use an elegant editorial serif for major headings and a clean modern sans-serif for labels, controls and body copy.
imageGenerationPromptTemplate.layoutInstruction: Use generous whitespace, clear hierarchy, accessible controls, subtle borders, restrained shadows and responsive-friendly composition.
imageGenerationPromptTemplate.imageryInstruction: Use natural editorial yoga photography with warm daylight, ivory interiors, linen, plants and authentic calm poses.
imageGenerationPromptTemplate.avoidInstruction: Avoid neon colors, heavy gradients, clutter, admin-dashboard styling, excessive shadows, generic gym imagery, illegible text and watermarks.
imageGenerationPromptTemplate.prompt: Create a [SCREEN NAME] for the Kratika Yoga customer platform. Use warm ivory #F7F3EC as the main background, deep forest green #213D34 for headings and primary actions, muted sage #879C86 for secondary accents, terracotta #C98768 for links and warm highlights, white #FFFFFF for elevated surfaces, charcoal #24302C for body text, slate #66716D for helper text, and border gray #D8DDD8. Use elegant serif headings, modern sans-serif body text, generous whitespace, 12px control radii, 20px card radii, accessible contrast, subtle borders and minimal shadows. Include [REQUIRED CONTENT]. Use natural editorial yoga photography with warm daylight and organic materials when imagery is appropriate. Avoid gradients, clutter, neon colors, generic gym styling, admin-dashboard aesthetics and watermarks. Keep all UI text correctly spelled and readable.
